jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: ING Australia — develop predictive algorithms and explore data to drive insights that power the bank's analytics capability.
jobs.description:
ING Australia has a passionate team of data-loving people who maintain the data and analytics capability of ING's banking platform.

## About the Role
As a Data Scientist at ING, you will harness data to draw out insights and inform decision-making, acting as an analytical powerhouse fuelling strategic moves.

## Responsibilities
- Develop predictive algorithms using ING's banking data
- Explore databases and identify opportunities for innovative ideas
- Build data models and analytical solutions to support business decision-making
- Maintain and enhance ING's data and analytics capability

## Requirements
- Demonstrated experience in data science or a related analytical role
- Proficiency with predictive modelling and advanced analytics
- Strong SQL and Python/R skills for data exploration and modelling
- Background in financial services or similar data-rich industry preferred
- Based in Sydney

jobs.title: Graduate Program 2026 – Enterprise Data & Analytics
jobs.snippet: NAB 2026 Enterprise Data & Analytics graduate program — apply advanced analytics and ML to unlock data-driven insights across the bank.
jobs.description:
Enterprise Data & Analytics teams are at the core of NAB's business. They see data as the currency of the future and unlock data to provide insights, drive impactful decisions, serve customers better and transform the business.

## About the Role
Use your analytical capabilities to help make data-driven decisions and apply advanced analytics to discover insights through data science, automation and artificial intelligence.

## Responsibilities
- Use advanced analytics and machine learning techniques to discover actionable insights
- Build new analytic capabilities for customers and the business
- Apply data science, automation and AI to solve real banking challenges
- Contribute to a team that sees data as a strategic asset

## Requirements
- Australian or New Zealand Citizen or Permanent Resident
- Degree completed between 2023–2025 or completing by January 2026 in a quantitative discipline (Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering)
- Demonstrated analytical ability and interest in data-driven decision making
- 15-month rotational program commencing February 2026, based in Melbourne

jobs.title: Graduate Program 2026 – Data Analytics & Management
jobs.snippet: Telstra 2026 Data Analytics & Management graduate program — provide data expertise and insight generation on projects essential to Australia's largest telco.
jobs.description:
Telstra's 2026 Graduate Program in Data Analytics & Management offers graduates the opportunity to provide data expertise and support best practice solutions on projects that have a real effect on the business.

## About the Role
As a graduate, you'll provide data expertise and support best practice solutions in the analysis and insight generation of datasets and data solutions so that Telstra is making the best decisions for its business.

## Responsibilities
- Provide data expertise and insight generation from datasets and data solutions
- Work on projects that are essential to Telstra's business operations
- Apply analytical and data science skills to real telecommunications challenges
- Collaborate across teams to deliver data-driven outcomes

## Requirements
- Degree completed 2023–2025 at an Australian University, or in final year of study
- Relevant degree: Business Information Systems, Computer Systems/Science/Engineering (combined with data), Information Technology, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Data and Systems Engineering
- Australian or New Zealand Citizen, Permanent Resident, or valid work visa
- 14-month program commencing February 2026

jobs.title: 2026 Technology (Cloud) Graduate Program
jobs.snippet: Westpac 2026 Technology Cloud graduate program — explore data analysis, machine learning, data engineering and big data with a six-month rotation.
jobs.description:
Westpac offers a structured Technology (Cloud) Graduate Program providing hands-on experience and ongoing support to set graduates up for a successful career in data.

## About the Role
In the Data Platforms function, graduates explore key areas such as data analysis, machine learning, visualization, data science, engineering, and big data, with a rotation after six months into another area within the data space.

## Program Highlights
- Structured learning and hands-on experience across data and cloud technologies
- Six-month rotation into another area within the data space
- Exposure to data analysis, ML, visualisation, data science, engineering, and big data
- Ongoing support and mentoring throughout the program

## Requirements
- In final year of study of a university degree, or completed an undergraduate or postgraduate degree within the past three years
- Australian or New Zealand Citizen or Australian Permanent Resident
- Available for Sydney or Melbourne locations

jobs.title: Launch Graduate Program – Associate Analyst (Feb 2026)
jobs.snippet: Mastercard Launch Graduate Program — analyse market and customer data to extract insights that drive strategic decisions on global payment technology platforms.
jobs.description:
Mastercard Australia's Launch Graduate Program is designed to immerse graduates in the world of global payment technology, offering hands-on experience across data analytics and strategic business analysis.

## About the Role
As an Associate Analyst, you will analyse market and customer data and leverage data tools to extract insights that drive strategic decisions.

## Responsibilities
- Analyse market and customer data using data tools to generate strategic insights
- Support cross-functional analytics initiatives across Mastercard's business units
- Contribute to strategic business analysis within one of the world's leading payment networks
- Gain exposure to global payment technology platforms and the global fintech ecosystem

## Requirements
- Recent university graduate or final year student in a relevant discipline (Business, Economics, Data Science, Finance, or related)

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer – Domain
jobs.snippet: Domain Group (CoStar) — Senior Data Engineer in Pyrmont Sydney for the team overseeing Data, Analytics, BI and AI across the group.
jobs.description:
Domain Group, now part of CoStar Group, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join their Sydney (Pyrmont) team. Domain's data team oversees Data, Analytics, BI and AI for the group.

## About the Team
The Domain data team has over 15 years' experience in Business Intelligence, Data Science and Machine Learning, and is dedicated to providing seamless access to data and analytics across the business.

## Responsibilities
- Design, implement, deploy, test, and maintain data pipelines for Domain's property marketplace
- Build innovative data products and insights within a high-traffic consumer platform
- Maintain metrics, carry out data analysis, and visualise data for business stakeholders
- Work with the Data Decision Science team to reduce complexity in data systems and enable use of data for innovative solutions

## Requirements
- Demonstrated experience as a Data Engineer or similar role
- Strong skills in data pipeline development, cloud data platforms, and SQL
- Experience with data modelling and data quality practices
- Background in consumer tech or marketplace data platforms preferred
- Based in Pyrmont, Sydney (on-site or hybrid)

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer (Modeling), Afterpay Risk
jobs.snippet: Block Afterpay — architect and build ML systems powering fraud prevention and abuse mitigation across the lending lifecycle.
jobs.description:
Block (Afterpay) is seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to architect and build ML systems that power fraud prevention and abuse mitigation across the Afterpay lending lifecycle.

## About the Role
Machine learning and data science are foundational to how Afterpay protects and scales its lending products. As a Staff ML Engineer, you will lead the design of production ML systems for risk management.

## Responsibilities
- Architect and build ML systems for fraud prevention and abuse mitigation across the lending lifecycle
- Design end-to-end ML model pipelines from feature engineering through to production serving
- Lead technical strategy for ML modelling within Afterpay Risk
- Collaborate with product, engineering, and policy teams on risk ML roadmap
- Mentor engineers and drive technical excellence across the ML platform

## Requirements
- 7+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with strong ML modelling expertise
- Experience building production fraud or credit risk ML systems
- Proficient in Python; familiarity with ML deployment and MLOps practices
- Can work remotely from anywhere in Australia or New Zealand, or from offices in Melbourne or Sydney

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Risk ML
jobs.snippet: Block Afterpay — leverage analytical skills to identify and prevent fraud and credit risks, working cross-functionally with product, engineering, operations and policy.
jobs.description:
Block (Afterpay) is seeking a Data Scientist to join its Risk ML team, applying analytical skills to identify and prevent fraud and credit risks across Afterpay's lending platform.

## About the Role
You will operate cross-functionally with product, engineering, operations, and policy teams to build data science solutions that protect Afterpay customers and the business.

## Responsibilities
- Develop data science and ML solutions to detect and mitigate fraud and credit risk
- Operate cross-functionally with product, engineering, operations, and policy teams
- Build analytical models that inform risk decision-making at scale
- Design experiments and evaluate model performance in production environments

## Requirements
- 3+ years of experience in data science or a related analytical role
- Experience with risk modelling, fraud detection, or credit analytics preferred
- Strong Python and SQL skills for data analysis and modelling
- Excellent communication skills to translate data science findings for cross-functional teams
- Can work remotely from Australia or New Zealand, or from Melbourne/Sydney offices

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.snippet: Nine Network — mid-level Data Engineer to build great data products, reduce data system complexity, and partner with stakeholders on innovative data solutions.
jobs.description:
Nine is investing heavily in its Product and Technology data team to make data a competitive advantage, recruiting several new Data Engineering roles.

## About the Role
As a mid-level Data Engineer at Nine, you will work with key stakeholders to build great data products and reduce the complexity in Nine's data systems, partnering with stakeholders to enable the use of data to create innovative solutions for the business.

## Responsibilities
- Contribute to the delivery of solutions that meet agreed objectives and deliverables while delivering high business value
- Produce efficient, reliable, and maintainable enterprise-grade software solutions
- Build great data products and reduce complexity in data systems
- Partner with stakeholders to enable innovative, data-driven solutions across Nine's media properties

## Requirements
- Demonstrated mid-level data engineering experience
- Strong SQL and data pipeline development skills
- Ability to build scalable, enterprise-grade data infrastructure
- Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills
- Salary circa $100,000 package; based in North Sydney

jobs.title: Data Graduate Program
jobs.snippet: ANZ Data graduate program — 18-month rotation through the Data team for a comprehensive view of data's importance to ANZ.
jobs.description:
ANZ's Data Graduate Program is designed to deliver better, more impactful customer propositions into the market faster. Over the 18-month program, graduates rotate through the Data team and gain exposure to various areas.

## About the Role
Data at ANZ is about delivering better, more impactful customer propositions into the market faster. By the end of the program, you'll have a comprehensive view of data and its importance for ANZ, with the opportunity to kick off your data career at one of Australia's leading banks.

## Program Highlights
- 18-month rotational program through ANZ's Data team
- Exposure to various data disciplines across the bank
- Structured career development and mentoring
- Opportunity to secure a permanent role upon graduation

## Requirements
- Recent university graduate or final year student in a relevant discipline (Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or related)
- Strong analytical and technical aptitude
- Australian or New Zealand Citizen, Permanent Resident, or eligible work visa holder
- Based in Melbourne

jobs.title: Machine Learning / AI Engineering & Research Internship
jobs.snippet: 苹果AIML北京实习——参与大语言模型、扩散模型、强化学习研究，专注用户隐私与AI公平性。
jobs.description:
Apple 人工智能与机器学习（AIML）部门面向在读生招聘机器学习/AI工程与研究实习生，加入北京研发团队。

## 岗位职责
- 参与大语言模型（LLM）、扩散模型和强化学习方向的研究工作
- 在 Apple 深度集成的软硬件平台上开发突破性AI体验，同时保护用户隐私
- 探索自然语言理解（NLU）、自然语言生成（NLG）、结构化预测、无监督学习与表示学习等方向
- 参与语音合成（TTS）或问答系统相关研究项目
- 将研究成果应用于无障碍、隐私保护和AI公平性等实际产品场景

## 岗位要求
- 计算机科学、人工智能、机器学习等相关专业在读硕士或博士研究生
- 熟悉 TensorFlow 或 PyTorch 等主流机器学习框架
- 具备自然语言处理、无监督学习或语音相关方向的研究经验
- 英文读写能力良好

## 关于Apple AIML
Apple AIML部门在大模型研究、多模态理解、个性化推理等方向持续投入，以用户隐私为核心原则，致力于将前沿AI研究转化为面向数十亿用户的日常体验。
